title: Deli Dining at Dal-Italia
summary: Dal-Italia Delicatessen in Hermanus presents a dining experience straight from Italy every Friday night.
description: Dal-Italia Delicatessen in Hermanus presents a dining experience straight from Italy every Friday night. The deli’s indoor and outdoor seating offers the best of both worlds. Downstairs brings a lively deli vibe, upstairs is a bit more traditional, and the courtyard is perfect for a relaxed alfresco experience. Fabio Lenci’s special Chef’s Menu features both new favourites and classics, along with activities such as wine-tasting experiences. Booking is advisable, especially for larger tables. Dal-Italia Delicatessen is proud to be affiliated with another iconic cuisine landmark, the much-celebrated Fabio’s Ristorante on St Peter's Lane.
profile: Every Friday night Dal-Italia Delicatessen on Aberdeen Street in Hermanus serves Chef Fabio Lenci's special Italian menu, with seating in the deli, upstairs or in the courtyard, and activities such as wine tasting. Diners book a table for the evening. It suits anyone wanting an Italian dinner out.

title: Benguela Cove parkrun
summary: A free, fun, and friendly weekly 5km community event.
description: A free, fun, and friendly weekly 5km community event. Walk, jog, run, volunteer or spectate – it's up to you! Every week we grab a post parkrun coffee at Benguela Adventure Centre - please come and join us!
profile: A free weekly 5km timed parkrun at Benguela Cove every Saturday morning. People walk, jog, run, volunteer or spectate, then join the group for coffee at Benguela Adventure Centre. It suits runners and walkers of any pace.

title: Betty’s Bay Parkrun
summary: Betty’s Bay Parkrun is a weekly 5km community event held every Saturday morning at the Harold Porter National Botanical Garden.
description: Betty’s Bay Parkrun is a weekly 5km community event held every Saturday morning at the Harold Porter National Botanical Garden. The Parkrun is free, fun, and friendly, with a stunning view of mountains, ocean and the botanical garden. Whether you walk, jog, run, crawl, or do a combo, you can travel at your own pace. Although times are recorded and sent to you for your benefit, everyone who finishes the Parkrun is a winner, whatever their placing! If the physical activity is not for you, Betty's Bay Parkrun welcomes volunteers and spectators because every fantastic event needs a solid backup crew and enthusiastic fan base! So grab your walking or running shoes, load friends, family and work colleagues into the car, and see you at the Betty's Bay Parkrun!
profile: A free weekly 5km parkrun every Saturday morning in the Harold Porter National Botanical Garden, with views of mountains, ocean and the garden. People walk, jog or run at their own pace, or volunteer and spectate. It suits families and walkers or runners of any level.

So grab your walking or running shoes, load friends, family and work colleagues into the car, and see you at the Groeneweide Parkrun!

title: The Gansbaai Market
summary: Gansbaai’s Farmer’s Market every Saturday and on pre-announced occasions in-season.
description: Bring your shopping basket and tell all your friends to meet you at Gansbaai’s Farmer’s Market every Saturday and on pre-announced occasions in-season. Gansbaai Market / Gansbaai Mark is the place to be if you love local vibes, sustainable shopping and delicious food. Get together with the community as you shop for organically grown produce, plants, handmade gifts, and an ever-changing selection of upcycled and preloved goods on sale at the Gansbaai Market / Gansbaai Mark. Stock up on a tasty selection of bottled condiments, artisanal bakes and delicious takeaways! For added enjoyment, the Gansbaai Market / Gansbaai Mark has picnic tables and chairs, a jungle gym for the kids and a DJ playing all your favourite hits.
hints: A Market For The Whole Family
profile: Gansbaai's farmers' market runs every Saturday morning on Market Square, with organic produce, plants, handmade gifts, preloved goods, artisanal bakes and takeaways. Visitors shop, sit at the picnic tables while a DJ plays, and children use the jungle gym. It suits families and anyone who likes local markets.

title: Rewilding Greater Gansbaai
summary: Help protect and restore the local landscape by clearing invasive plants.
description: Join Rewilding Greater Gansbaai on Saturday, 7 November, to help protect and restore our beautiful local landscape by clearing invasive plants. Volunteers will meet at 09:30 AM at the Restaurant at Groeneweide Farm in Franskraal. Please remember to bring a hat, sunscreen, sturdy boots, a small handspade, and plenty of water. As a token of appreciation for your time and hard work, free coffee will be provided for all helpers after the event. Remember, it takes one landscape and many hands—we look forward to seeing you there!
profile: A volunteer morning with Rewilding Greater Gansbaai, clearing invasive plants to restore the local landscape, meeting at the restaurant at Groeneweide Farm in Franskraal. Volunteers bring a hat, sunscreen, boots, a hand spade and water, and get free coffee afterwards. It suits visitors who want to help with conservation.

title: Kleinmond Chess Club
summary: Anyone who is interested in joining can pop in at the Kleinmond Library every Tuesday evening from 18:00 to 20:00.
description:
Kleinmond Chess Club was founded in August 2016 and has come a long way since. Initially, the intention was for like-minded adults to meet weekly for a game of chess but our club also started admitting junior members in 2019 due to great demand from the youngsters in our area. Our membership numbers have steadily increased largely due to our open door policy and the fact that we strongly feel that our club is for people of all different age groups and skill levels interested in playing chess within our community. Kleinmond Chess Club is also part of the Overberg Chess Federation.
Although our club is for social chess purposes we do however host a number of internal championships throughout the year to keep things interesting and play for a top spot on our ranking scoreboard to keep the competitive spirit alive within our group. Anyone who is interested in joining can pop in at the Kleinmond Library every Tuesday evening from 18:00 to 20:00
profile: Kleinmond Chess Club meets for social chess at the Kleinmond Library Hall every Tuesday evening from 18:00 to 20:00, and anyone interested can pop in. Players of all ages and skill levels play games, with internal championships during the year. It suits chess players visiting Kleinmond.
